request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the gloomcast. A colossal grazer that strains buried vegetation and small animals from the sand during long crossings of the open dayside. It sheds the stored heat fiercely when it reaches shade. Body plan: a long, low, slab-sided barrel of a body carried on exactly six thick pillar legs in three pairs, three legs on each side, a land animal. Every foot is a broad pad with three short blunt toes, the same in every facing. The torso, shoulders and head form one continuous wedge sloping down to the ground, with no separate domed back and no distinct neck. The head is dominated by a broad, flat, scoop-shaped sieve mouth of fine comb plates held close to the ground across the full width of the front, with small eyes set high and far back on the sides of the head. The hide is smooth and close-grained, overlapped in broad heat-shedding scale-plates with darker seams between them. The tail is a short, thick, blunt counterweight. The spine carries exactly five dorsal fans in one midline row. Each fan is a broad, thin, veined radiator sail standing upright in the vertical plane that runs along the length of the body, attached to the centre line of the back. Keep the same five fans at the same spine positions in every facing. In side view the five sails show their full broad veined faces in a row along the spine, with the legs showing six in a row, the far-side legs partly hidden behind the near ones. In front view, with the eyes toward the viewer, the same five sails turn their thin edge to the viewer and show as five narrow upright blades stacked in one line up the midline: one rising behind the head and four more behind it, each slightly smaller than the one in front, their tips stepping up in a staircase, with only a hint of vein texture, and the shoulders free of fans. In rear view, seen from behind with the eyes hidden, the same five thin blades stand in one narrow column above the back and haunches, and exactly six legs show: the large hind pair nearest the viewer, with the middle and front pairs partly hidden behind it, each leg joined to the body, and a dark belly shadow in the gap between the two sides. Colour: one coherent muted palette, dusky grey-brown hide with slightly warmer fan edges, with no red or yellow anywhere. Style: realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite, painted with visible brushwork and strong value variation, flat painted value shapes with a lit top and a darker belly, selective detail. Soft painted edges; value and colour contrast against the ground carry the silhouette. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background with a clean antialiased cut-out edge in which every edge pixel matches the adjacent hide shade: no ground, no water, no cast shadow, no text, no border.
